subject: SIG request: temporary tenant event exports & retention clarification
messages:
From: Emily Sato <emily.sato@acme-sys.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mike Ross <mike.ross@acme-sys.com>, audit@acme-sys.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up: request for tenant event exports (short window)

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. ACME's audit team is preparing SIG evidence and asked if Redwood can provide a time-bounded export of tenant event logs (system events + application-level inference traces) for a 30-day window (2026-05-20 to 2026-06-19). Our reviewers want:

- A downloadable export (CSV/NDJSON) with timestamps in UTC
- A manifest describing field names, redaction rules applied, and retention markers
- A brief note on how Redwood isolates tenant events from other customers and any PII redaction that occurs

We'd prefer a short-lived presigned S3 link if possible; audit will download and then verify checksums. Can you confirm what we can provide within the next five business days and any limitations (rate, sample size, or fields removed)?

Emily
Emily Sato
Security & Compliance, ACME Systems
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Sato <emily.sato@acme-sys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: request for tenant event exports (short window)

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear checklist. Short answer: yes, we can produce a time-bounded export and supply a presigned S3 URL with a short TTL. A couple of quick notes and constraints up front so expectations are aligned:

- We can export both platform-level events and per-tenant request traces for the date range you specified. Exports come as NDJSON; we can provide CSV for selected fields if needed.
- PII/identifiers: by default we redact API keys, full input blobs for user prompts when policy flags are hit, and obvious email addresses. We can also provide a fully redacted export (hashed identifiers) vs. a pseudonymized export if your auditors require linkage.
- Size & time: for a tenant with typical production volume (<= 1 TB compressed logs for the window) exports are generated asynchronously; turnaround is typically 48-72 hours. Larger payloads may require chunked exports.
- Access: we'll produce a presigned S3 link valid for 72 hours and deliver a manifest + SHA256 checksums.

Soojin from Security will own the redaction and evidence mapping; Marissa will coordinate the delivery and any billing/contract questions if a special extraction is requested. We'll kick off this work once you confirm acceptance of the default redaction profile (attached).

Cheers,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Sato <emily.sato@acme-sys.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 08:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: request for tenant event exports (short window)

Hi Emily — following up with the proposed extraction plan and redaction profile. See attached SIG_Evidence_Map_v1.3.pdf for field-level mapping; highlights below: 

- Fields exported: timestamp_utc, tenant_id (hashed), request_id, model_name, token_count, event_type, latency_ms, response_status, agent_id (redacted), request_payload_summary.
- PII handling: email addresses, user-provided free text in prompt bodies, and API keys are redacted. If you need verbatim prompts, we can provide those under a stricter access agreement and with additional redaction controls.
- Isolation proof: extract includes a tenant_id hash salted by a tenant-specific key — this proves separation without releasing raw tenant identifiers.
- Retention metadata: each row will include original_log_timestamp and computed_retention_cutoff (ISO8601).

If this mapping satisfies auditors, we will schedule the export job for Wednesday (2026-06-24). Please confirm whether you want NDJSON or CSV for the final download and whether your team will accept hashed tenant IDs.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Mike Ross <mike.ross@acme-sys.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Emily Sato <emily.sato@acme-sys.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 07:52:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: request for tenant event exports (short window)

Thanks, Soojin. Two quick clarifications from Audit/Ops: 

1) Our auditors prefer CSV for easier ingestion into their tooling. Will field-order be stable across chunks?
2) Can you include a separate small sample (10k rows) with unhashed tenant_id and verbatim prompt bodies under a stricter temporary access window (we can sign an addendum or NDA for this purpose)?

If the sample requires legal paperwork, we can get that turned around quickly — want to know the path so we can avoid delays to the SIG deadline.

—Mike
Mike Ross
Platform Ops, ACME Systems
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Sato <emily.sato@acme-sys.com>, Mike Ross <mike.ross@acme-sys.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: request for tenant event exports (short window)

Emily / Mike — good questions, and we can accommodate both asks with the following operational steps: 

- Format: We'll produce chunked CSV exports with stable field order and an export_manifest_20260622.csv that lists chunk names + SHA256 checksums. CSV will be the primary artifact for your ingest.
- Sample with verbatim data: We can provide a limited sample (up to 10k rows) containing unhashed tenant_id and verbatim prompt bodies. This will be delivered to a restricted S3 bucket and requires a short access addendum (text in presigned_export_instructions.txt). If ACME signs the addendum and confirms the authorized personnel list, Security will enable the sample for a 24-hour presigned URL.
- Timeline: assuming addendum signed by end of day Friday (2026-06-26), we'll start the export job Friday night and present a download link Monday morning (2026-06-29). The full export (if <= 1 TB compressed) will be ready within 72 hours of job start.
- Attachments: we've added the evidence map and the instructions file to the shared Drive link above; presigned link will be delivered via encrypted email with checksums in the body.

Please confirm acceptance of the addendum requirement for the verbatim sample and whether you want the full export to be zipped or left as chunked CSVs. Once you confirm, I'll open the internal ticket and Soojin will review the extraction scope.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
